reason: A 65-mile double summit and circumnavigation link-up, which none of our single-peak routes is.
A Shasta plus Shastina link-up that goes up Avalanche Gulch and down the West Gully. Our Avalanche Gulch route descends the same way and is not a link-up, so the loop is not our route.

The track climbs the 5.4 Northeast Face from Happy Isles. Ours are the Southeast Face (a Mountain Project page puts it at the gap between the middle and north domes, which differs from the Northeast Face) and the West Face.
